Description trimmed to meet the 8000-char completion admission limit. Full plan-amendment text preserved here:

## Plan amendment — what actually landed (2026-08-22, session takeover after the owning session terminated)

The merged fix (change 2115, commit a42a9d8d494) implements plan steps 1, 4 (partially), and 5
— restore `timeout = 300` in the ini AND in both `_build-and-test.yml` shared-tier lanes'
explicit `--timeout=300 --timeout-method=thread` flags, with the headroom contract tests. The
ini-floor mechanism (plan steps 2/3/6: `tests/_timeout_floor.py`, flag-free lanes, inverted
parity assertions) was NOT implemented: the operator merged the change from outside its own
gate, which the four-lens RCA (see comments) proved is the ONLY provenance-valid path for a
workflow-text fix — the Verified gate executes `_build-and-test.yml` from trusted main
(GitHub-documented reusable-workflow resolution), so patchset-effectiveness via a conftest
floor solved a problem the merge path made moot. The lanes therefore still carry explicit
flags, guarded by the ORIGINAL (un-inverted) parity tests, now at 300.

Residual scope dispositions:
- Loadgroup crash-cascade (one dead worker re-dispatches the crashing item to every respawn,
  burning toward the job ceiling): fixed by follow-up 8a4f-f0f4-ed92-4c70 (change 2119,
  merged 53eaea07aa2) — `--max-worker-restart=0` on the loadgroup lane + parity test.
  cac1-6391-7944-470e (same class) is closed.
- Fixture-phase hang gap (`timeout_func_only = true`): still open as 797b-bbc4-01cf-42d5.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `[tool.pytest.ini_options].timeout` is 300 (pyproject.toml:662 on main a42a9d8d494);
      verified by `test_timeout_budget.py::test_the_configured_budget_is_the_measured_one`
      (passes, 2026-08-22 run of the Verification block: 31 passed).
- [x] Budget >= 2x the measured 29.93 s worst legitimate body and <= 600 s with thread method;
      verified by `test_timeout_budget_headroom.py` (both tests pass).
- [x] [superseded] The ini-floor arms (`test_a_stale_tighter_cli_flag_cannot_undercut_the_ini_floor`,
      `test_the_floor_is_not_a_ceiling`) were dropped with plan step 2 — see the plan
      amendment above: the external-merge path makes main's own workflow text carry 300, so
      no floor is needed for the landed shape; patchset-side undercut is no longer reachable.
- [x] An unmarked over-budget test with no CLI flag is still killed by the ini alone; verified
      by `test_an_unmarked_over_budget_test_is_killed_by_the_ini_alone` (passes).
- [x] `@pytest.mark.timeout(N, func_only=True)` still overrides ini and CLI; verified by
      `test_a_marked_test_may_outrun_the_ini_budget` (passes, out-of-process form).
- [x] Both `_build-and-test.yml` shared-tier lanes carry `--timeout=300 --timeout-method=thread`
      (lines 666, 681 on main) — the landed single-value shape, guarded by the ORIGINAL
      `test_the_shared_tier_lanes_carry_the_ini_timeout_budget` (passes; the plan-step-6
      inversion was dropped with the floor).
- [x] Every CI pytest lane has a per-test hang guard; verified by
      `test_every_ci_pytest_lane_has_a_per_test_hang_guard` (passes, original form).
- [x] [restated] Replication: the "own Verified run" criterion rested on the floor mechanism
      and was disproven by the RCA (a workflow-text fix is inert on its own run — trusted-main
      provenance). The replication oracle is instead POST-MERGE Verified runs on main at/after
      a42a9d8d494: runs 32592533861, 32592528558, 32592145329 all completed SUCCESS with zero
      worker-crash lines, where every pre-fix run failed.
- [x] Integration-tier jobs reach a terminal conclusion within `timeout-minutes`: the same
      post-merge runs completed within budget; the crash-cascade burn class is additionally
      bounded fail-fast by change 2119 (`--max-worker-restart=0`, follow-up 8a4f).

## Verification

    pytest tests/unit/test_timeout_budget.py tests/unit/test_timeout_budget_headroom.py \
           tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py -q
    pytest tests/scripts -q -n 4 --dist worksteal
